text: Thanks — I'm on it. I've started investigating the bug in src/click/core.py (missing required flag handling) and will have a fix ready in about 8 minutes.
Got it — bug #2 (echo with no streams, touching _compat.py/_termui_impl.py/utils.py) is now being worked on in parallel with bug #1. ETA ~10 minutes for both.
Bug #3 (envvar value for a flag option, in src/click/core.py) is now being investigated too. ETA ~14 minutes for all three; I'll report as each is fixed.

Bug #2 is fixed and verified. click.echo (and pager/progressbar) no longer crash with AttributeError when sys.stdout/sys.stderr are None (pythonw / no console): _compat._make_cached_stream_func now returns None for a None source stream, utils.echo returns early when no stream is available, and _termui_impl falls back to StringIO. Full test suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.
Bug #4 (argument decorator used multiple times must preserve cls, in src/click/decorators.py) is now being investigated. ETA ~18 minutes for the remaining three; I'll report as each lands.
Bug #5 (symlink resolution, src/click/types.py) is now being investigated. ETA ~22 minutes for the remaining four; I'll report as each lands.

Bug #4 is fixed and verified. In src/click/decorators.py, argument() was popping "cls" out of its closure attrs on first use, so reusing the same click.argument(...) decorator object fell back to the base Argument class. It now copies attrs like option() does. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.
Bug #6 (flag + default_map, src/click/core.py) is now being investigated. ETA ~26 minutes for the remaining four; I'll report as each lands.

Bug #5 is fixed and verified. In src/click/types.py, Path.convert used os.readlink() before os.path.realpath(), which broke relative symlinks (resolved against the cwd instead of the link's directory) and made valid symlinks fail with exists=True. It now uses pathlib.Path.resolve(). Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.
